labels: Let me go at my own pace.

nodes.text: And suddenly, $ZOE sees the truth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam... Is that what this entire day has been about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `You're` feeling down.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] feeling down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's why you're trying to cheer me up. It's because `you're` also sad.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's why you're trying to cheer me up. It's because [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] also sad.

nodes.text: Sam is silent for a moment... And then she breaks down in front of $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's been really hard...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In a very short amount of time, I've had `two` really bad breakups.
nodes.text_bbcode: In a very short amount of time, I've had [color=#3b78e2][i]two[/i][/color] really bad breakups.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know if I'll ever stop being heartbroken.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was hoping that if I could cheer you up... Maybe I'd be happier too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I was really caught up missing Howard... I didn't even think about how you were feeling.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't even asked in a while.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's okay... At least I know that Nick and Colt weren't right for me, and that's why we broke up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You and Howard... Well, in a way, it's so much harder.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, look at us. Aren't we both pathetic?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Well, at least we're pathetic together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... At least we are...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on... Let's head home...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Curling up on the couch watching a movie sounds pretty good right now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes!
They walk outside with their gelato and pass the mall's fountain.
Suddenly, the boys playing around the fountain splash $ZOE! She drops her gelato cup.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, Lee, you missed!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Whoops! Sorry, Nate!
Nate comes up to $ZOE and Sam, looking apologetic.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, sorry about that... Lee was aiming for me... But he's not the best shot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not that bad.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, you're $ZOE, aren't you? I've seen you around school.
$ZOE glances at Sam behind him. Sam mouths the words: `'It's just talking.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE glances at Sam behind him. Sam mouths the words: [b]'It's just talking.'[/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, I'm $ZOE. This is my cousin Sam. And you are?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm Nate. Nate Crawford.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nice to meet you.
Nate looks at the gelato on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Looks like you weren't the only casualty here... Can I offer to buy you a new one?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... That's really sweet, but you don't have to do that.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You sure? It wouldn't be a problem. I happen to be a great gelato-buyer.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha... I'm sure you are. But it's all right. Really, I was pretty much done.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, I can't let you go home without anything. This entire thing's my fault.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: If you don't want gelato... How about I take you out to a movie this Friday?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh... I can't...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I get it. Busy girl.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: How about Saturday? And if movies aren't your thing, I bet you've never gone rock climbing before...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... That won't work either.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Sunday brunch?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't stop, do you?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Life's too short to take no for an answer...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And I think we could have a lot of fun together... So what do you say?
$ZOE is saved from answering, as the power in the mall goes out for the second time that evening...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you want to be alone, that's fine!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But let me tell you... Being alone isn't all that fun either!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine. I get it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I have been trying too hard...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I just hate seeing you so sad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not fun being alone.
$ZOE hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go ahead. Say whatever you're thinking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can't you leave me alone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I'd appreciate it if you would just...

options.label: Let me go at my own pace.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, `sorry`... All you do is stay at home and feel sorry for yourself..
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]sorry[/i][/color]... All you do is stay at home and feel sorry for yourself..

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All I want is for the old $ZOE to come back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The old $ZOE isn't around anymore. And it doesn't matter how many hours we shop.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not going to cheer up just because you want me to.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm really babying you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of... You're trying too hard to make me happy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're driving me to the mall, you're buying my clothes, you're getting my favorite gelato...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And, honestly, it almost makes it harder to cheer up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to be sad around you, but that's how I'm feeling these days...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Uh' what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need you to stop bothering me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I need you to stop...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I know that you care a lot about me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you talking about? We're `family.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you talking about? We're [color=#3b78e2][i]family.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that... I just mean...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm assuming that you care about me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... You're my... Classmate?
A few minutes later...
$ZOE steps out wearing the miniskirt and shows it off for Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You look amazing! What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not sure how I feel about it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you talking about? It's awesome! Check it out in the mirror!
$ZOE turns, checking herself out in the mirror.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess it's not that bad...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Not that bad'? It totally shows off your legs! Now you `have` to get it!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Not that bad'? It totally shows off your legs! Now you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to get it!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I guess... If it'll make you feel better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! In fact... You're going to wear it out of the store!
A few minutes later...
$ZOE steps out wearing the shirt.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey... What do you think?
Sam bites her lip and gives $ZOE the once-over.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... It's nice?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you `really` think?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's boring.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's just mean.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I told you before... It looks exactly like your old shirt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And sometimes... What's old is boring.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm not going to get it then.
$ZOE places it back on the rack.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, fine...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate to say it, $ZOE... But I think you're being too emotional.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're never going to get over Howard if you don't try. You need to go out and do things.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The $ZOE I know wouldn't hole up in the house forever. She'd get out and bake cookies and be super nice to everyone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know where that $ZOE went.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's in there somewhere... And I have a great idea for getting her out.
Sam drags $ZOE into the most expensive store in the mall.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... What are we doing? We can't afford anything in here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not true... If I help you pay for something, we can afford one really cute new thing for you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you don't have to do that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, I promised you fun, so you're going to have fun. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I `know` there's nothing you love more than getting some brand new clothes!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] there's nothing you love more than getting some brand new clothes!

nodes.text: Sam rushes off to the back of the store while $ZOE wearily browses a shopping rack.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hate to disappoint Sam, but... None of this is helping...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look what I brought you!
Sam holds up a pink miniskirt.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That skirt is way too short!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think the term is 'mini'. And I think it would look awesome on you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You `have` to try it on.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to try it on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not really into it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just `consider` it, $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just [color=#3b78e2][i]consider[/i][/color] it, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry... I just mean that you can't say you don't like something until you `try` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry... I just mean that you can't say you don't like something until you [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm beginning to sense a theme here...
$ZOE looks at the rack closest to her and picks out a green shirt.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if I wear this?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Choose what you want.
$ZOE considers both.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The shirt seems like it'll be more comfortable...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the skirt is definitely something new...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll try on the...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It hurts. It hurts that I can't hug him or see him or talk to him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We agreed not to contact each other for the first month he's away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it's driving me crazy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I've been where you are. I know you miss Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But can't you miss him `and` shop with me at the same time?
nodes.text_bbcode: But can't you miss him [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] shop with me at the same time?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha.
$ZOE manages a small smile, but it disappears quickly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All I can think about is how good we used to be together and how happy I was...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know we said long distance would be too hard... But so is this!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Snap out of it, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even if `you` want to get back together with him...
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] want to get back together with him...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not up to you, is it? Howard has to agree to it too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... You're right...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe I just don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A couple months ago, you thought Student Council was for 'dweebs like Justin'...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And now it's the most important thing ever to you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: More important than your friends? More important than your `boyfriend?`
nodes.text_bbcode: More important than your friends? More important than your [color=#e23b3b][i]boyfriend?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe it is! And maybe I should be at home working on it right now!
Taylor storms out, Brendan following closely behind.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's still raining! Where are you going to go?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anywhere but here!
They walk into the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, are you guys coming back anytime?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: The goblins have started ransacking our rucksacks...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And all the gold we've been hoarding is gone!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We've been ran`sucked.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We've been ran[color=#e23b3b][i]sucked.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor stops and waves her hands.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know, I know, okay? I'm sorry! I suck.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm leaving!
Taylor opens the door...
And that's when the power goes out...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, that's just great!
Across the city, at the mall, $ZOE and Sam flounder around in the sudden darkness!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's just great. How are we supposed to shop now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can't. I think that's a sign... We should go home...
The lights flicker back on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There we go! Come on, $ZOE. Let's hit Blouse House.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, Sam... To be honest, I don't really want to be here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd rather just curl up at home...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: After all the work it took to convince you to go out in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We can't leave now! We have to shop!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do we?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! Besides, where are we going to go? It's `storming` outside. We might as well wait for it to go away.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! Besides, where are we going to go? It's [color=#3b78e2][i]storming[/i][/color] outside. We might as well wait for it to go away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... I guess so...
Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, ever since Howard left for Kingston, you've been a total mope!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's been impossible to get you to do anything!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... Howard and I had something special.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't just forget it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You really think that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The decisions I make about the budget, the social events, the academic calendar...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: They're going to affect every student at the school! Of course the Presidency is important to everyone!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but in the grand scheme of things... It kind of doesn't matter.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, we won't be here that much longer...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So all the things you've done won't have too much of an effect, will they?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes, they will! They'll definitely have more of an effect than some stupid game...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'Some stupid game'? Is that what you think of all this?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, it's not real-life!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Great! Well!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You must be pretty proud of the fact that you've made us lose to Mordack.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe I am!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm taking my job very seriously!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Probably more seriously than anything I've ever done before!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, I get that...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But you're not in a Student Council meeting... You're with us...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And we're trying to defeat Mordack's horde of goblins...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Not texting on your phone all the time about this pointless stuff.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pointless?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, er... I mean, point`ful?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, er... I mean, point[color=#e23b3b][i]ful?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Have you heard a word I've said?
Brendan sighs.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, crap.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Mordack, sensing his opportunity, sends another swarm of goblin minions forward.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: This time, no one can fight back.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You have all died.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No... Not after coming this far...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Can you guys excuse me? I'd like to talk to my girlfriend IRL.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: IRL? Like, 'In Red Lipstick'?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I mean, I'm not opposed, just a little surprised...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, IRL as in `in real life`...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, IRL as in [color=#e23b3b][i]in real life[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just... Just come with me...
Brendan leads Taylor into the den.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor, I'm happy you're President. Ecstatic even.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And people are really happy that you're not Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I didn't know that turning into President meant that you'd stop being part of the group.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's like you're not even here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I'm `sorry` that I'm a little pre-occupied with things that actually matter!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]sorry[/i][/color] that I'm a little pre-occupied with things that actually matter!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This was supposed to be the biggest quest of our campaign! It matters way more than text-bickering with Justin!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You just don't get it, do you? The Presidency is...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: There's no one `named` that in the game...
nodes.text_bbcode: There's no one [color=#e23b3b][i]named[/i][/color] that in the game...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know who I mean... He's the... Uh... Guy...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I have no idea who you're talking about...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, fine! I guess I'll shoot the ogre with an ice arrow!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hit!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not the ogre!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Taylor, Brendan `is` the ogre! He was turned into one by Mordack!
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor, Brendan [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] the ogre! He was turned into one by Mordack!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: In either case, he's been hit. Roll for critical.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, maybe I'll roll a 1...
Taylor takes a die and rolls a 20.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How does she do that? It's like a magic power!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And the ogre has fallen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You have three seconds to make a decision...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I attack Mumbletack!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You have three seconds to make a decision...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I attack Mumbletack!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I shoot an ice arrow at Mordack!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The ice arrow flies through the air! It hits Mordack's foot, and ice shoots up his leg!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes! That's good!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Unfortunately, Mordack has a minor immunity to ice, and he breaks free!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: We knew he had an ice immunity from earlier, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh... That's bad.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: With a roar the magnitude of fifty lions, Mordack hurls his mighty Axe of Atrocity at your party!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: He strikes the ogre!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, that's good, right?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Except that, if you recall, `Brendan` was put under a spell by Mordack and turned into the ogre.
nodes.text_bbcode: Except that, if you recall, [color=#e23b3b][i]Brendan[/i][/color] was put under a spell by Mordack and turned into the ogre.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Brendan's character goes down!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You have three seconds to make a decision...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I attack Mumbletack!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor, you have to be more careful. We really need you to focus. `On the game.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor, you have to be more careful. We really need you to focus. [color=#e23b3b][i]On the game.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine... I'll try harder, I swear.
Dex clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The goblins swarm the party and start hammering away...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ashlandia the Warrior... Your move.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'm not sure... Let me think...
In the silence that follows, Taylor turns back to her phone.
It reads: 'Sign off needed ASAP!'

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who knew I'd ever care this much about being `President?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Who knew I'd ever care this much about being [color=#3b78e2][i]President?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And who knew I'd ever be talking to Justin this much?!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The goblins are a huge threat! Their numbers are overwhelming!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I bet our ranger has a couple ice arrows up her sleeve for `exactly` this moment...
nodes.text_bbcode: I bet our ranger has a couple ice arrows up her sleeve for [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] this moment...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Doesn't she?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? Huh? What am I shooting at?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The goblin hordes rise around you, Mordack rises from a wall of fire, and an ogre lumbers along next to you...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm going to shoot...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And you fail.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? I didn't even roll!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Seeing as your party was just `ambushed,` taking the treasure upfront was never possible.
nodes.text_bbcode: Seeing as your party was just [color=#e23b3b][i]ambushed,[/i][/color] taking the treasure upfront was never possible.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The goblins overrun your party, blithely clubbing you in the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Because you were confused, you take 50 hit points of damage.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh! No way!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's... Well, okay...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You duck, and the goblin's club swishes harmlessly over your head!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See? I'm paying attention!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Barely.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Unfortunately, since you ducked, the club now hits your friend, the one-armed giant.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ouch! Clubs are my fifth least favorite thing to get hit by!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess I'll try taking the loot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aren't you the one who's always saying school comes first?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're not at school right now. You don't have to worry right `now` about `next` year.
nodes.text_bbcode: We're not at school right now. You don't have to worry right [color=#e23b3b][i]now[/i][/color] about [color=#e23b3b][i]next[/i][/color] year.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Can we move on now?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, of course...
Taylor reluctantly sets her phone down.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ahem... As I was saying... The party converges upon the dark castle of Mordack...
Taylor's phone beeps again. She picks it up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, Justin again. Being President is like being popular... But in a totally sucky way.
Taylor starts texting back.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Go on without me. I can listen `and` text, you know.
nodes.text_bbcode: Go on without me. I can listen [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] text, you know.

nodes.text: Dex continues onward, pushing the party forward while Taylor texts furiously on her phone.
Until...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor, it's your turn. What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Huh? What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I thought you could 'listen and text'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course I can. I was just deciding what to do...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that is, uh... I want to...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If I don't figure out a good program to take money out of, there won't be a Prom.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is bigger than just me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't want Justin taking funds out of clubs you care about, do you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What if he wanted to take from chess club? Or computer club? Or... Or...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nerd club?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I understand your concern...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But you're the one who said you'd play Ogres 'N' Elves with us.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And you're not participating.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Urgent? Like if you don't respond today, our entire school will fall apart?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, the actual budget's not due until next week, and we're kind of meeting tomorrow, but...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So, it's not `actually` urgent.
nodes.text_bbcode: So, it's not [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] urgent.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It `feels` that way!
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]feels[/i][/color] that way!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I have a lot to do now that I'm President!

nodes.prompt: Would you like to check out the novel now?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Would you like to check out the novel now?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I just wish she'd pick up her phone.
The house phone rings then, and Mr. Kessler rushes to pick it up.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hello?
Emily can't hear what's being said on the other line...
But she sees her father clutch his chest as if struck...
And a cold chill runs down her spine.
Back at Brendan's house...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just can't believe that you would be so insensitive...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We've been planning this campaign for weeks!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, `I` didn't plan for a budget crisis to come up, but here we are!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] didn't plan for a budget crisis to come up, but here we are!

nodes.text: Their arguing is interrupted by Taylor's phone beeping. She reaches for it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? Can't even keep your attention on the tragic chaos that you caused for just one second?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't see how it's any of your business how I respond to texts.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You can talk to whoever you want... But does it have to be now?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what? It does!
Taylor checks the text.
The anger drains from her face...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I hope the budget isn't in `too` much trouble...
nodes.text_bbcode: I hope the budget isn't in [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] much trouble...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, Brendan... It's... Not that.
Taylor hands the phone to Brendan, and he and the others read its tiny screen.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no...
At the mall, Sam, $ZOE, and Nate recover from the lights going out.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So, $ZOE... What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nate... I can't. It's just not the right time...
All at once, their phones beep.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Weird. We all have texts at the same time?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, looks like it went to everyone at school...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just hope it's not another Dirty Dish rumor.
Nate shakes his head as he skims the text.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No... There was a car accident... A bad one.
Quickly, $ZOE and Sam read the text.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Do you know the people involved?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, we do... I can't believe it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Sara... Nick...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara... Nick...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A few days later...
On a clear night...
Taylor takes the stand in front of a gathering of every student and staff member at Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A few days ago, we learned that a tragedy occurred.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We lost one of our own in a terrible accident.
Taylor looks over to the memorial that the school has set up.
Soft candlelight and white flowers illuminate a large, silver frame holding a photo of `Sara Kessler.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Soft candlelight and white flowers illuminate a large, silver frame holding a photo of [b]Sara Kessler.[/b]

nodes.text: Next to the frame, the Kessler family stands by, their eyes downcast.
And towards the back, Nick stands quietly in a shadow, stitches on the bridge of his nose and his arm in a sling.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Most of us weren't that close to Sara...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She broke a national record, you know, and only a handful of us even heard about it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But the one thing I did know about Sara was her earnest determination in sports and in life.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I remember once, a long time ago... When Sara was competing in a different kind of race...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She said that she hadn't lost since she was four, and that she wasn't planning to lose anytime soon.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's that spirit of optimism that really defined Sara.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: When she had her heart set on something, she always tried to move towards it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that's a good lesson for us to live by and a good way for us to remember her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We should live our lives dreaming big, aiming high, and always moving forward.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Even though we didn't get the honor of being her close friend while she was alive...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She was one of us, and her passing has affected us all.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sara Kessler will live on in our memories.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...And in our hearts.
Taylor lets a moment of silence hang heavily in the air. Then she leaves the podium.
All at once, everyone in the crowd forms a line around the altar of Sara's portrait.
One by one, they begin laying white flowers down on her memorial.
Towards the middle of the line, Taylor finds Brendan waiting for her.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor, I'm... I'm... Sorry about what I said before...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shh, it's okay, Brendan... I know...
Brendan takes her hand, and they start to move with the line.
At the very back, Sam and $ZOE huddle together, comforting one another.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's so sad. She was our age, and she was in our class...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I used to see her around... But I never talked to her. I feel bad now that I didn't really think about her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `I` feel bad that I was so horrible to her for the last few months...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] feel bad that I was so horrible to her for the last few months...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hated her so much when Nick and I broke up...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And even though I was still mad at her... I never wanted this to happen...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Nick... I didn't want this for him either.
$ZOE and Sam take white flowers from an offered vase and get into line.
Nate falls in behind them.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Nate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm really sad to hear about your friend.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: How are you two holding up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Someone `died.` What do you `think?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Someone [color=#3b78e2][i]died.[/i][/color] What do you [color=#3b78e2][i]think?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Sorry... I thought...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Sorry. It `was` a dumb question. I just thought I should ask.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry. It [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] a dumb question. I just thought I should ask.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you can ask somewhere else.
Nate looks down at the ground, but $ZOE touches his arm.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, Nate... You're concerned. That's nice of you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be honest, this is really hard on us...
$ZOE bites her lip, and her eyes glisten.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It makes me really think about how life is so fragile and short...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bad things happen, and you don't know when or where...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And what's sad is that you or me or Sam get to go on and live our life...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Sara will never get that chance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wish... I wish things had turned out differently...
$ZOE bursts into tears then.
Nate steps in and pats $ZOE gently on the back.
Sam takes her cousin's hand. They stand with $ZOE as she sobs...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Things... They're going to change now, aren't they?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. Sara died, and a part of us went with her...
Sam spares a glance at Nick. Their eyes meet, but they both quickly turn away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And none of us will ever be the same again...
At the front, Emily looks dully at the procession, holding a small bouquet of white flowers.
Even though she's surrounded by family and friends, she still feels hollow inside.
Each new flower laid down next to Sara's photo makes her feel worse and worse.
Finally, the line dwindles, and her parents step up to the memorial to pay their respects.
Emily tries to shrink back, but her father gently pushes her forward.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Emily... It's time...
Emily stands in front of her sister's picture, her hands trembling.
The only thing Emily sees when she looks at Sara's face is the future they'll never have together...
She thinks of all the jokes they'll never share when their father is being ridiculous...
Of all the times they'll never spend laughing and sharing stories...
Of how they'll never swim together again...
The last thought makes Emily feel lonelier than ever.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You never did tell me what your secret for breaking the national record was...
Emily thinks this at Sara's picture as if her sister might reply... But no answer comes.
After a long moment, Emily goes up and lays flowers upon Sara's memorial, her tears spilling as she tries to say good-bye...

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Shelter? Where is she going to find `shelter` in this storm?
nodes.text_bbcode: Shelter? Where is she going to find [color=#e23b3b][i]shelter[/i][/color] in this storm?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And she's taking the backroads through the woods!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: A tree's not going to help her out!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It was just a thought! I don't know what happened to her!
Her dad sighs heavily.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: No, of course not.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Which is exactly what you taught her.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: She should take her time, be careful, and not risk twisting her ankle.
Her dad sighs heavily.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Yeah. You're right. I probably won't ground her then.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah... `Sara` is always there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara[/i][/color] is always there.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoa. Sounds like you're not happy about that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did something happen? I thought you two were close.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Nothing happened.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But I feel like I'm always in her shadow.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: She's going to be Sara Kessler, the girl who broke the national record.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And I'm just her little sister.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Trust me, I know what it's like to have your sibling be better than you at something...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But it doesn't matter how many records Sara breaks...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We're going to make a name for ourselves at school. You'll see.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm almost afraid to ask what we're going to do.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee hee.
At that moment, Coach Kessler appears in the doorway.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, Mr. K!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hi, Kimi. Emily, have you heard from your sister?
Emily checks her cell phone and shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No... I haven't heard anything.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She was supposed to be home an hour ago! I can't imagine why she's still out there.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And she's not picking up her phone.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Have you seen the storm outside? I don't think her phone's working.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I barely have any reception on mine.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: When she gets home, she's going to be grounded for being so irresponsible!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't go overboard, Dad. She hasn't done anything wrong... She's probably...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What's to worry about? You swim. In a pool.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If you ask me, you worry entirely too much about swimming.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Honestly... I think you could take some time away from even `thinking` about swimming.
nodes.text_bbcode: Honestly... I think you could take some time away from even [color=#3b78e2][i]thinking[/i][/color] about swimming.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Besides, your sister just broke the record, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sure she can give you tips. She's always there for you, isn't she?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What, like aliens?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No... Like... Where are we going to sit? Who are we going to talk to?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Will our teachers be good or bad?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You have a point...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Is high school going to be fun?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Don't worry about that... We're going to be together. It'll be great!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And if you're worried about friends...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sara will be there. She'll take care of you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But, geez, I can't believe I only have a few weeks to decide!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know. That's hardly any time.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You seem so confident and excited. Aren't you just a little bit nervous?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm too excited to be nervous. We have so much to look forward to!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Boys... Dances... Boys...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What are you worried about anyway?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm worried about...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Everyone is going to dress up, and that looks the most formal to me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah... I'll probably play around with the shirt color, but that makes sense.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Glad to help.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The high-waisted thing looks unique.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You'll really stand out.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't want to stand out `too` much though. I mainly want to fit in.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't want to stand out [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] much though. I mainly want to fit in.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine. Don't take my fashion advice then.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're the one who watches the designer shows anyway...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry... I'll take what you said into account...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The basic outfit looks the most normal.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't `want` to be normal. I want to be perfect.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to be normal. I want to be perfect.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I want to fit in, but I don't want to be completely under the radar.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine. Don't take my fashion advice then.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're the one who watches the designer shows anyway...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry... I'll take what you said into account...
And across town, in Emily's house, where she and Kimi are having their ritual sleepover...
The lights flicker for a moment, then...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Lights are back on!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Woo hoo! That means the TV's back on!
Kimi eagerly navigates to the channel playing Friday Night Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Aw... We just missed the last part. Darn.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry, Kimi... I know how much you love FNS.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's okay... I can watch the episode on their website. No big deal.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But I'll tell you what is!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: In a few weeks, we will be going to high school for the first time ever in our lives!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And hopefully the `last` time...
nodes.text_bbcode: And hopefully the [color=#3b78e2][i]last[/i][/color] time...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee hee... You know what I meant. Now... I need you to help me with something important.
Kimi digs into her overstuffed backpack and pulls out a bunch of clothes.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I need you to help me pick out what I'm going to wear on the first day of school.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're already planning that?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It helps to be prepared. Everyone knows that you dress up on the first day of school.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The question is how.
Kimi shows off a gray pencil skirt with a blue collared shirt.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's business casual, but do you think it's too much?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Or do you think trendy is better?
Kimi takes out a high-waisted skirt with a turquoise blue chevron and a plain white tee to match.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is it too fashionable? Maybe I should just go basic.
Kimi pulls out jeans and a lacy shirt.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eh? What do you think? Business casual, trendy, or basic?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm not really good at fashion... But I'd go with...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm not really good at fashion... But I'd go with...
The girls leave the store.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't understand what just happened. Why are you upset?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm trying really hard to cheer you up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you're doing that by making me try on a skirt that I don't even like?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just want you to leave your comfort zone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm already out of it. Howard left. And I don't know if I'll ever be comforted by anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And here we are again. At least you went ten minutes without thinking about him this time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Woo hoo.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's focus on something else...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe we ought to get a snack...
They make their way to the food court.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, a new gelato place just opened up... You like gelato, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...
For a moment, $ZOE resists, thinking about one of her first dates with Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...This is the best dessert in town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hah. I never would have thought the big, tough football star would have a soft spot for desserts.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I was only thinking of you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just kidding. I appreciate it. Thanks for taking me here...
...$ZOE shakes it off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure...
In the gelato shop...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why don't you snag a table? I'll get us some small scoops.
$ZOE walks through the small shop, looking for a table. She accidentally bumps into a guy's soda!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!
The guy lurches forward and smoothly catches the soda can right before it tips onto $ZOE's shirt!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I'm so sorry.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, no worries. I'm just glad you're fine. I'd hate to ruin a pretty girl's day.
He winks at her as he and his friends clear out. $ZOE takes the table.
Sam brings two small scoops of gelato over.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who was that hottie you were just talking to?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... Just some guy...

nodes.speaker: Sam

Later...
After most of the students have paid their respects and left...
Nick walks up to Sara's father who is the only one left. He stares blankly at the memorial.
Mr. Kessler...
I have nothing to say to you, and I'm not interested in what you have to say.
But...
Sara's father turns on Nick, anger simmering underneath a layer of immense grief.
It's your fault that this happened.
I know.
And you have the nerve to show your face at `my` daughter's `memorial.`
I cared about Sara too.
I loved her.
And if you'd really cared, you wouldn't have let her drive.
She begged `me` to teach her. You couldn't protect her forever.
And you didn't protect her at all.
Now she's gone.
Silence settles over them as they both face the silver frame with Sara's photo.
Whatever you think... I did care about her.
And I want to attend the funeral.
Only people who were an `important` part of Sara's life can come.
You'd better stay away.
But...
This is my last warning. Don't ever approach me or my family again.
Sara's father walks away, his gray form fading in the darkness.
And in the dying light of the flickering candles...
Nick stands alone.

nodes.title: The Storm, Part 2
nodes.subtitle: Sometimes there's a storm before the calm...

nodes.text: Outside, the skies are dark and gray, and the rain patters hard against the windowsills.
It's the first big storm of the season, and newly-appointed President Taylor is sitting at the kitchen table in Brendan's house with the rest of the nerds.
Taylor glumly takes the offered mug of hot chocolate that Brendan hands her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This sucks... I can't believe I had to cancel the first Student Council meeting of the year... All because of the stupid rain!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Isn't it supposed to be bright and sunny and beach-y this time of year?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, at least you're not in the storm.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, but I'm not discussing the annual budget that's due at the end of the week either.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Neither is anyone else on the Council.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess. But we have so much work to do... I want to start as soon as possible.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, just relax. Think of it as your last break before you put your nose to the grindstone.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why? Do I have a blackhead?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A what?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Hey, guys... If Taylor's staying... We can finish the rest of the Havenplace campaign!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah! We've been wanting to do that for weeks!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do you say, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure...
Within a few minutes, Dex and the others have set up their game.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay! This is going to be so great!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Finally, the epic ending to our quest!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And let us begin!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We start on the threshold of the castle of Mordack the Fierce.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Mordack has been terrorizing the nearby town of Havenplace...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: He's been taking advantage of the townspeople: demanding tribute, stealing their food, and most recently, enslaving their young.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: As your party enters his dark fortress, each member of your party thinks...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: 'Will today be the day Mordack faces justice? Or will it just be another slaughter?'

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Mwa ha ha ha ha!
The sound of a beeping phone pierces the air.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whoops.
Taylor picks up her phone and reads a text from it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's Justin. He says it's important. We have to talk about the next year's budget. It'll just take a minute.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Then the fate of Havenplace awaits your return.
Taylor reads the text: 'No money for after school tutoring. Taking out of Prom budget. Do you sign off?'

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? He's got to be kidding me. No way the Prom money's going into his super lame program!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And why does he have to spell everything out? It's a text. Geez.
Taylor texts something furiously back. A moment later, the phone beeps again.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh! I hate this budget thing! Who knew you actually needed math for something?!
She texts back for several more minutes while the others give each other uncomfortable looks.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, Taylor... We're not going on without you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just a sec...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Can't it wait?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan, this text is...
